- Redwood: Marissa (sales), Camila (onboarding/solutions), legal & finance as needed

- Standard SOC2 and security questionnaire responses completed (we've already shared SOC2 doc and audit report link)
- Legal review of SOW and standard T&Cs
- Procurement internal approvals & PO issuance

Questions / asks for FinTechCo:
1) Can you confirm procurement's internal signature deadline for Q2? We proposed 2026-04-09 to align with your pilot timing.
2) Who on your legal team should we expect comments from (name + email)?

Attached: initial MAP draft (FinTechCo_MAP_v1.1.xlsx) and SOW draft. These are intentionally light; we want to align on dates and owners first.

If the proposed procurement signature date (2026-04-09) works, we'll mark the MAP as target-close = 2026-04-09 and route SOW for legal. If procurement needs more runway, tell us the date and we will update the MAP accordingly.

Thanks —
